"Casino 7s" has 424,942 prizes of $5 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $1,000 prize, with 34 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

The table below shows the full count for "Casino 7s", with every prize level included.
2775.headline: Prize table details

2776.body:
The most common win left on "Patriotic Payout" is $2. The second biggest prize left is $500, and 123 of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

If "Patriotic Payout" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2776.headline: Prize table details

2779.body:
"Gnome for the Holidays" has joined the Texas lineup at $1 with 57 top prizes of $500. Only on the first day do the printed odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

Tomorrow's count on "Gnome for the Holidays" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2779.headline: A new game is here

2780.body:
"Holiday Countdown" just reached Texas stores with five top prizes of $100,000. A new game is the easiest kind to judge. No prizes have been claimed, and the printed odds are accurate for now. Every day of sales changes that, and this page tracks it.

Everything above about "Holiday Countdown" comes from the Texas Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2780.headline: First day on sale

2781.body:
"The Perfect Gift" is new from the Texas Lottery. It is a $10 game with five top prizes of $250,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Today's free summary of "The Perfect Gift" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
2781.headline: New in stores

2782.body:
"$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" just went on sale in Texas. The game has eight full prize levels with four top prizes of $1 million. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

If you play "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
